title: Il pleut
summary: Apollinaire's rain calligramme, set as falling rain by the browser's own layout engine while the DOM keeps five plain sentences.
mechanism: CSS writing-mode:vertical-rl flows horizontal source sentences into vertical rain that wraps to — and re-lengthens with — the window's height; a toggle returns the layout engine to prose.
references: Guillaume Apollinaire, Il pleut, from Calligrammes (1918)
Concrete poetry (Eugen Gomringer, Augusto de Campos)
Stephane Mallarme, Un Coup de Des (1897)
